abstract: At the Spring Convention at Hollywood a report was made of the activities of the Projection Theory Committee. A subcommittee to examine the literature of the subject was formed, consisting of C. Tuttle, F. K. Moss, and H. P. Gage, Chairman. The present plan of this Committee is to prepare a tutorial paper on the progress of the optics of motion picture projection, based principally on the papers published by of the Society of Motion Picture Engineers, but also referring to significant papers in other publications.
